name: anotoki/lib
description: What the anotoki sites share, the PHP half: the database migrations (the engine, the site gate and the admin routes), the translations (the schema, the words' routes and the command line), signing in (the IAM's tokens, who a request is, the boot configuration, a stand-in IAM for tests) and people (the site's record of them and the GDPR scrub). The Angular half is @anotoki/lib.

suggest.ext-curl: asks the IAM with curl (PHP's own streams otherwise)
suggest.ext-zlib: the backups compress with it (Backups needs it)

scripts-descriptions.test: The PHPUnit tests: PostgreSQL from ANOTOKI_LIB_TEST_DB_CONFIG or ANOTOKI_LIB_TEST_PG* (README.md)
